Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. President Reagan upsets San Franciscans and persons with AIDS with his homophobic comments 2. Former Senator John Schmitz apologizes for his offensive comments regarding pro-choice women and homosexuals 3. Philadelphia Lesbian and Gay Task Force offers recommendations for educating homosexual students to school board COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser 4. Texas employees attempt to change anti-discrimination laws to include protection for homosexuals 5. Andy Humm on acceptance of homophobia in the media 6. Newspaper for Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Chicago rejects ad from Catholic groups calling for support of gay civil liberties COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 7. Coverage of the protest against the Georgia sodomy laws and the Rehnquist Supreme Court COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 8. Coverage of protests against Jerry Falwell's rally in support for anti-abortionists COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation with Jose Sarria 9. Minneapolis begins media campaign to educate general populace about AIDS 10. Study finds that homosexuality in men may be a genetic or familial trait 11. Government scientist finds a new AIDS-related virus 12. Reading of thank you letters to Gay Cable Network 13. Sports Report 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Interview with director Leslie Irons and actor David Drake regarding their new play, "Dancin' in the Dark," with clips COMMERCIAL: GCN's "SUDS" gay soap opera looking for locations 3. Coverage and interviews regarding the new film "The Name of the Rose" 4. Closing credits
